item.title: When Effie Met Effie: Watch Jennifer Hudson & Jenifer Lewis Perform a ‘Dreamgirls’ Duet
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our show, where music meets magic. Today, we're talking about a powerful duet that's taking the internet by storm. Jennifer Hudson and Jenifer Lewis, two singing sensations, came together on The Jennifer Hudson Show to perform a show-stopping rendition of "I Am Changing" from Dreamgirls.
[Short music transition]
Host: The story behind this performance is fascinating. Jenifer Lewis, who replaced Jennifer Holliday in the workshop production of Dreamgirls, had a chance to share her experience with Hudson. She revealed that she developed the role of Effie, while Holliday took it to Broadway, and Hudson, of course, brought it to life on the big screen in the 2006 film adaptation.
[Short music transition]
Host: Lewis suggested performing "I Am Changing", a song she hadn't sung since she was 19 years old. The result was pure magic. The two vocal powerhouses went back and forth, their voices blending together in perfect harmony. The audience was wowed, and the energy was electric.
[Short music clip of "I Am Changing"]
Host: As they finished their performance, Hudson and Lewis shared a heartfelt hug, exchanging "I love you"s. Hudson was clearly thrilled, exclaiming, "I got to sing with Jenifer Lewis, yo! I'm living a dream right now."
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. If you want to see the full performance, be sure to check it out on The Jennifer Hudson Show. It's a must-watch for any music lover. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll see you next time.
